EARTH:elevation_m: doc: ETOPO 2022 global RMSE vs ICESat-2 (MacFerrin et al. 2025)
EARTH:tmin_c: doc: WorldClim 2 cross-validation RMSE of minimum temperature (Fick & Hijmans 2017, Table 3)
EARTH:irradiance_kwh_m2_day: doc: WorldClim 2 cross-validation RMSE of solar radiation 1.45 MJ/m2/day = 0.403 kWh/m2/day
EARTH:lst_diurnal_amp_k: doc-derived: MOD11 QC best class 'average LST error <= 1K' per overpass, day minus night -> sqrt(2) K
EARTH:rock_or_bare_frac: illustrative 0.05 (classification product; per-cell error not documented)
MOON:elevation_m: doc: LOLA geodetic grid ~10 m radial accuracy (Smith et al. 2010)
MOON:tmin_c: doc: Diviner NETD < 1 K over 60-120 K (Hayne et al. 2017, citing Paige et al. 2010)
MOON:lst_diurnal_amp_k: doc-derived: max minus min, each with 1 K -> sqrt(2) K
MOON:irradiance_kwh_m2_day: illustrative 2 % (geometry formula plus LOLA illumination fraction)
